title: Search Archive Request
description: Public request schema for the search_archive workflow. Supports conversation_id, query, project, date_from, date_to and limit as defined by the current Make input boundary.

project.description: Project filter. The workflow normalizes this value internally before matching against the stored project key.

date_from.description: Inclusive lower date bound. When date_from and date_to are equal, the workflow treats the request as an exact-date search.

date_to.description: Inclusive upper date bound. When date_from and date_to are equal, the workflow treats the request as an exact-date search.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of results to return. The workflow uses 10 when no limit is provided.
